scenario: A weekly traveler uses a Realme X7 Pro and a USB-C laptop. The frozen phone listing says that a 65 W charger is included and advertises a full charge in 35 minutes. The traveler wants one brick for the phone and laptop, is comparing a 65 W single-port UGREEN PD charger with a 100 W four-port Cirtek charger, and is worried because a previous phone battery swelled after two years of nightly fast charging. They prioritize verified device, cable, protocol, and port compatibility over the largest printed wattage and will keep separate known chargers if the one-brick route is not established.
target: Audit the complete frozen Realme X7 Pro, Cirtek 100 W, and UGREEN 65 W bodies; the Quick Charge, USB-C, charger-control, battery-management, and lithium-ion mechanisms; and the charging-speed, 5 W, temperature-hold, and fast-charge explainer discussions. Recommend one route or defer while preserving exact port allocation, device and cable conditions, seller attribution, owner scope, price and review anomalies, temperature boundaries, and every missing compatibility, safety, and longitudinal measurement.
